title: Runs remain halted after halting
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, let $\text{oracle}$ be an oracle, let $x$ be an input bit string, let $v$ assign a natural-number value to each of the $m$ registers, and let $r$ be an optional Boolean result. Running from the halted configuration with register values $v$ and result $r$ leaves that configuration unchanged for every finite choice string.
